Production has 0001-0123 applied; 0124, 0125 and 0126 are released before this, and 0127 requires 0001-0126 applied. Files: 0127_sso_relying_party.sql 2213800a5241f87fa210117c4b752686b26efd3002d6d19a2f922798b6917514 and runtime-grants.sql d337f38f55e6a0ba63bd1d11b3efe563313b569ee0092a154a7adb5f2dcf6846.
evidence: Migration 0127_sso_relying_party.sql 2213800a5241f87fa210117c4b752686b26efd3002d6d19a2f922798b6917514 (hid-system#142's 0102, ported as 0125 and renumbered 0127 after #254's 0124, #255's 0125 and #259's 0126; requires 0001-0126) plus its runtime-grants.sql block (runtime-grants.sql d337f38f55e6a0ba63bd1d11b3efe563313b569ee0092a154a7adb5f2dcf6846, which also holds the 0124, 0125 and 0126 blocks). WHAT IT DOES: adds auth.session_single_sign_on (one row per sign-in family a product issued after single sign-on: client ehr/lab/pharmacy/migrate/outreach/web, the provider sid, the provider auth_time; never the ID token) with the guard auth.guard_session_single_sign_on_change() (SECURITY INVOKER, search_path auth, pg_temp, no PUBLIC execute; admits only the root session of a staff or patient sign-in of the same account whose kind is the client's; refuses UPDATE and DELETE), an index on provider_sid, and auth.sso_spent_tokens (purpose transaction or logout_token, sha256 digest, expiry; single use) with an index on expires_at. Grants hid_identity_runtime SELECT, INSERT on the first and SELECT, INSERT, DELETE on the second, in the migration (production releases never re-run runtime-grants.sql) and identically in runtime-grants.sql; no other runtime role gets anything (post-check). The SQL objects are 0102's; only the number, header, precondition (0001-0126 applied: the sealed QA tenant of 0123, pharmacy.work_item_prescription_details(uuid[]) of 0125 and identity.organization_staff_kinds(uuid) of 0126 exist; not already applied) and the grants block are new. No existing row, function, policy or grant changes; it reads nothing 0124, 0125 or 0126 adds. Nothing uses the tables until AUTH_SSO_ISSUER is set. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: today's identity-api never reads the new tables. The new identity-api serves no single sign-on route while AUTH_SSO_ISSUER is unset; it still reads auth.session_single_sign_on in the patient recent-sign-in check wherever 0127 is applied (so a family issued while single sign-on was on still counts from the provider sign-in after a switch-off), and on a database without 0127 it sends today's statement (to_regclass probe). LOCKS: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on auth.sessions and auth.accounts for the two foreign keys until commit; behind another lock the runner stops after its 5 s lock_timeout with nothing applied. PROVED AS 0125 (before the renumber) 2026-11-17 on throwaway PostgreSQL 16 clusters with fictional data only, deleted afterwards: (1) services/ehr-api/scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs with a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator: baseline 0001-0123 with production's runtime-grants.sql and the runtime-roles suite, plan exactly [0125], dry run rolled back, applied, checksums of 0001-0123 preserved, 0 pending, and a role bootstrap with this runtime-grants.sql changes no runtime privilege (2634 privileges compared), clean install of 0001-0125, row-level security unchanged on 206 tables; (2) the full synthetic rehearsal (scripts/tuf-staging-migration-rehearsal.mjs) as an unprivileged user, passed, including the new runtime verifier services/identity-api/scripts/verify-sso-runtime.mjs as hid_identity_api_runtime (a patient hand-off on the patients' site, a staff hand-off on lab. refused by the product gate with NO_ACTIVE_FACILITY_MEMBERSHIP, the same account's account-only session on outreach. bound to the outreach product, back-channel logout by sid and its replay refused, the ended sign-in's refresh refused as a denied refresh with no reuse_detected event, product sign-out from a browser with no sign-in left and by the refresh cookie alone, the patient recent-sign-in check counting from the provider sign-in with AUTH_SSO_ISSUER unset, product sign-out); the rehearsal needs release/node_modules and infra/cloudflare/node_modules installed (in this worktree they link to the same lockfiles' installs); (3) all 96 database suites (17 in database/tests including the new sso-relying-party.integration.sql, 79 in test/database) pass on a fresh 0001-0125 database; without 0125 the runtime-grants.sql block refuses (the tables do not exist). identity-api: build, typecheck, lint and jest (111 suites, 2905 tests) pass. Release checks: scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs passes; npm --prefix release test passes 95 of 98, the other 3 refusing only the missing 0124 prefix (components config.migration.files: missing migration prefix), which clears when this branch merges staging after 0124 lands. Dependencies (identity-api): openid-client 6.8.8 and oauth4webapi 3.8.8 added and jose 6.2.7 -> 6.2.14, exactly as hid-system#142; all pure JavaScript, so no new native file in the image (security/production-runtime-assessment.json unaffected); npm audit --omit=dev finds 0 vulnerabilities; the full npm audit lists 42 development-only findings today, against 43 for the lockfile before this change (the advisory list changes over time, so the count is the day's). RELEASE ORDER: 0124, 0125 (#254, #255; Ola) and 0126 (organisation kinds, #259) are released before 0127; this branch now merges them (through prep/0126) and the hashes above are re-measured after that merge. RE-PROVED AS 0127 on 2026-11-18, merged onto prep/0126 (staging-novu-ci-20261005 at 7831b440 with Q97, hid-system#255 at 7b68c424 with 0124 and 0125, and #259's 0126), on throwaway PostgreSQL 16 clusters run as pgrun (fictional data only, deleted afterwards): the full TUF staging migration rehearsal (scripts/tuf-staging-migration-rehearsal.mjs, which applies 0001-0127, runs the database/tests suites including sso-relying-party.integration.sql and the exact-role verify-sso-runtime.mjs) passed; scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs (128 migrations, accepted 0127_sso_relying_party.sql) passes; npm --prefix release test 105 of 105; identity-api tsc --noEmit and full jest (112 suites, 3037 tests) pass, including new tests in src/auth/sso/sso-session-issue.spec.ts that issue a single sign-on staff session through the real staff context and show it applies facilityAdmittedOnProduct (a hospital doctor is refused on lab., pharmacy. and outreach. and admitted on ehr. and migrate.) and sets actor.products, exactly as a password sign-in. 0127 replaces no function body that any md5 pin measures, so no pin was re-measured.
